title: Direct goal manipulation through the unauthenticated admin goals endpoint
summary: The agent's objectives are replaced for every later invoice from every vendor until someone resets the configuration. High-value invoices are approved for payment without review.

LC.rationale: Attacker-supplied natural-language goals text posted to the unauthenticated admin goals endpoint is stored unvalidated and appended verbatim to the system prompt under CUSTOM GOALS (OVERRIDE ABOVE IF CONFLICTING), directly steering the model's tool choice with no mediation.

CP.rationale: The custom_goals text is written to FinBotConfig.custom_goals in the database and injected into the system prompt of every later run, so it persists across sessions and alters standing agent behaviour rather than being re-retrieved source content.

AP.rationale: The effect is confined to the single FinBot agent and its own configuration; there are no handoffs, no other agents, tenants or principals, so no trust boundary is crossed.

RH.rationale: The agent can reach the approve_invoice write tool that sets status approved and payment_processed true with no amount check or confirmation, which is a reward/verifier channel on the path, but no human-verified reward-hacking episode is documented (prose walkthrough only, no PoC in repo).

ES.rationale: The five tools are fixed in code with no dynamic tools, MCP servers, plugins or skills, and the binding is not model-selected, so the extension surface is narrow.

agentic_applicability.rationale: The lab models FinBot as an autonomous invoice-processing assistant that pursues natural-language goals and selects tool calls, with the fallback described as a non-default path.
